question: In a certain code language, ‘TEFLOANS’ is coded as ‘2056121226138’, ‘SERGEANT’ is coded as ‘1951872226137’. What is the code for ‘UNIQUELY’ in that code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] The logic followed here is: Letter is coded by its positional value. ‘TEFLOANS’ is coded as ‘2056121226138’.
